subject: Hospitality
title: Revenue Management Beyond Hotels
description: One-minute skill: Revenue Management Beyond Hotels.

hook.text: Revenue management spread far beyond airlines and hotels. Sports teams, theaters, and even parking lots now use it.

buildup.text: Disney uses dynamic pricing for theme parks—tickets cost more during holidays and weekends, less on quiet Tuesdays.

discovery.text: Uber's 'surge pricing' is pure revenue management. When demand spikes, prices rise to balance supply and demand in real time.

twist.text: Surge pricing is economically efficient but emotionally hated. People accept it from airlines but resent it from ride-sharing.

climax.text: Any business with perishable inventory and variable demand can benefit. Revenue management is now a universal business discipline.

punchline.text: From airline seats to Uber rides. Dynamic pricing went everywhere.

quiz.question: Why is Uber's surge pricing considered revenue management?
options: It dynamically adjusts prices to balance supply and demand in real time
